name: Guardian Deity
description: A divine watcher. Senses evil across every world and travels to wherever a villain rises, calling heroes to stand with it. Always merciful; its blessing redeems.

journey.say_start: A sanctuary from which to watch over the worlds.
A great evil has awakened. Heroes - to me!
Even the darkest heart can be turned.

milestones.name: Divine Blessing
milestones.broadcast: %npc% has redeemed a fallen soul. The worlds feel lighter.

milestones.name: Divine Shield
milestones.say: You will not desecrate this world!

battle_cry: By the authority of the Kais - stop!
I will not allow this world to fall.
victory: Reflect on what you have done.
Go, and walk a better path.

requests.line: The balance of this world is fragile, %player%. Bring me %count% %item% - their life essence will help me mend it.
Dark magic leaves traces. Destroy %count% %mob% and you will weaken whatever seeks to wake.
